cases.translation: In that land the famine still raged.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Тот человек нас строго предупредил, не показывайтесь мне на ___.
cases.translation: That man solemnly warned us, do not show yourselves before my eyes.
cases.explain: The idiom показываться на глаза uses на with the accusative case.
The transitive verb привести takes an animate direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он вновь вышел и, совладав со своими ___, сказал.
cases.translation: He came out again and, having mastered his feelings, said.
cases.explain: The preposition с in the sense of dealing with something governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Положите в ___ лучшие плоды этой земли.
cases.translation: Put the best fruits of this land in the bag.
cases.explain: The preposition в expressing location takes the prepositional case.

cases.translation: Carry it as a gift to that man.
cases.explain: The recipient of the gift stands in the dative case.
The quantity word больше governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: The steward gave them water to wash their feet.
cases.explain: The partitive object of дать (some water) takes the genitive case.

reading.ru: В той земле по-прежнему свирепствовал голод.
reading.question: What condition persisted in the land?
reading.explain: The text says 'свирепствовал голод' (the famine raged).

reading.ru: Я лично буду за него порукой, с меня лично ты спросишь за него.
reading.question: What did Judah promise regarding Benjamin?
options: To be personally responsible for him
reading.correct: To be personally responsible for him
reading.explain: Judah says he will personally be surety (поруко́й) for the boy.

reading.ru: Возьмите вдвое больше серебра, чтобы вам принести с собой и то, что было положено обратно в ваши мешки.
reading.question: How much silver were the brothers told to take?
reading.explain: The text says 'вдвое больше серебра' (twice as much silver).

reading.ru: Затем он вывел к ним Симеона.
reading.question: Whom did he bring out to the brothers?
reading.explain: The text says 'он вывел к ним Симеона' (he brought Simeon out to them).

reading.ru: Он вошел к себе в комнату и там разрыдался.
reading.question: What did Joseph do in his room?
reading.explain: The text says he entered his room and 'там разрыдался' (wept there).

reading.ru: Они пировали и пили с ним в волю.
reading.question: How did the brothers spend the meal with Joseph?
reading.explain: The text says 'Они пировали и пили с ним в волю' (they feasted and drank freely with him).
